Trapped air bubbles from the sample will be analysed for methane at a laboratory in Nagano.

A command post will be established at Manhyia Palace Museum, situated within a 200-metre cordon, to coordinate the efforts. Officials cautioned that adjacent blocks remain unstable and projected the operation to last 24 hours. The incident occurred while contractor Osei-Bonsu Construction was pouring concrete when the structure collapsed.
